title: BookLayout-Bi: Bilingual Book Cover Layout Annotations and Fixed Experimental Splits
description: BookLayout-Bi provides 10,161 structured Chinese and English book-cover layout records and fixed experimental splits used to evaluate LGC-Net. The archive contains normalized annotations, cover-level attributes, provenance metadata, duplicate audits, split manifests, statistics, and validation tools. It does not redistribute original book-cover image pixels.
